name: dobe_todrinkb
desc: pink goo doberman seen from behind hugging someone tightly: it squeezes them harder with both arms pulling them in close, and pushes its head forward pressing its pursed muzzle flat onto their face like a deep kiss, mouth hidden on the far side, no teeth, no eye visible, goo strands oozing at the muzzle tip. Lower body stays stuck to the pillar. Smooth single motion
